meta.title: Reference parts prices for installation
meta.description: Reference prices by region for parts used in air conditioner installation, collected on site, plus contract pricing for brands and marketplaces.

title: Reference parts prices (collected on site by the technician)
lead: Bluebolt does not sell parts. The table below gives reference prices for extra parts used during installation; customers pay the technician directly on site.

table.title: Pipework parts for air conditioner installation
table.caption: Reference parts prices by region, VND per metre, excluding VAT
table.noteCapacityUnknown: The old price list does not state a unit capacity for this row.
table.specialAreas: Special areas: islands, border areas and remote areas.

filters.unknownIncluded: Rows without a stated capacity are always shown, with a note.

notes.title: Please note
notes.reference: Reference prices only; they may change depending on actual site conditions.
notes.agree: The customer and the technician agree on any extra parts on site, using this price list.
notes.quote: For a quote for a specific site, call <tel>{phone}</tel>.

hidden.title: The reference parts price list is being updated
hidden.body: The price list will appear once it has an official effective date. For a parts quote for a specific site, call {phone}.

contract.title: Contract pricing for brands, marketplaces and retail chains
contract.body: Installation fees for businesses are set by appliance group and region, written into the contract and reconciled per job. Extra parts still follow the reference prices above.

points.groups: Rates by appliance group and region
points.settle: Reconciled per job, with sign-off photos
points.separate: Service fees and parts kept separate

policy.title: Service policy
policy.lead: The full text is on the Warranty policy page. The policy has four parts:

general.title: Part 1. General terms
general.body: Service area, special areas, order intake hours and limits of liability.

customers.title: Part 2. For customers
customers.body: Complaints and technician changes, parts costs, warranty registration and periods.

technicians.title: Part 3. For technician partners
technicians.body: Working hours on site, urgent jobs, penalties and compensation.

brands.title: Part 4. For brands
brands.body: Division of responsibilities and joint incident response times.
